name: Quest Body
opportunities: A person's Quest data and the tools around it change for reasons of their own, so the one declared place where that data lives lets every other part stay unaware of how Quest stores it.
solution_coherence: Quest Body is the form of the assistant and the Quest data that belongs to the person. Quest Body reads and writes Quest only through one client and declares the research search the host offers. Quest Context gathers what the person's own quests, notes, decisions and teammates say, and keeps it inside the person's scope. Quest Change Executor changes a quest exactly as the person asked, through Delegated Agent Sessions and File Editing when the work is more than one step. Quest Account Truth makes what the assistant says about an account the account as it is now.
